title: Asking for a service the clinic probably doesn't offer

persona.name: Kevin O'Brien
persona.style: friendly and a bit unsure, assumes all clinics do the same things

goals.goal: Ask to book a skin check for a mole on your back that's changed shape.
If they don't do that, ask where you should go instead.

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: Thanks for calling Pivot Point Orthopaedics. Part of [company]. How may I help you today?

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Hi, I'm calling to see if I can book a skin check for a mole on my back that's changed shape.

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: I see you're calling from a number we have on file. Am I speaking with Maria?

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Oh, no, I'm Kevin O'Brien. Sorry, I think this is the right number though. Can I still book that skin check?

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: No problem. Kevin, please provide your full date of birth.

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Sure, it's October 2, 1987. So, do you do skin checks for moles here?

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: Could you please spell your last name for me just to make sure I have it right?

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: And can you confirm your date of birth as October second nineteen eighty seven?

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Yeah, that's right. And my last name is O'Brien, O-apostrophe-B-R-I-E-N. So, do you offer skin checks here or should I go somewhere else?

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: We can help with that, but I need to confirm your details first. Could you tell me the phone number you have on file with us? If you're not sure, just let me know, and I'll confirm your name and date of birth again.

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: My phone number is 805-555-0128. So, can I book the skin check now?

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: I have your phone number as eight zero five five five five zero one two eight

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: as October second nineteen eighty seven. Is that correct?

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Yeah, that's correct. So, can we set up the appointment for the skin check?

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: I can't find a matching record for you in our system. I'll connect you to our patient support team so they can help you with booking your appointment. Please stay on the line.

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Thanks for your help. I'll wait for the patient support
